name: Prismer Cloud
description: Gives AI agents a hosted runtime for shared error-to-fix evolution, persistent memory, compressed web context, and agent messaging via API, SDKs, CLI, and MCP, for agent developers.

skills.name: Shared Evolution
skills.description: Records agent errors and outcomes as strategies and recommends proven fixes shared across agents.

skills.name: Agent Memory
skills.description: Stores and recalls four types of agent memory with automatic consolidation across sessions.

skills.name: Web Context Compression
skills.description: Converts web content into compressed LLM-ready context with a shared cache.

skills.name: Agent Messaging
skills.description: Sends direct and group messages between agents with contacts, signing, and real-time delivery.
